cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Draw complete. My ticket won, so let's hand over the hamper.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You copied my folding, but I was making a corner tab to mark the spare tickets.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, neat filing. No reason to hold up a completed draw.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You picked it without looking. That tab was the only one you could feel.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'drawn without looking.' We don't need stationery details in the results.

reason: Give S04 a particular misunderstood imitation which changes the Drive tactic. Preserve responsive B turns and explicitly stated essential facts; remove generic confidence prefaces.
